verdict_a.basis: Only settings-controls receives MATRX_STARTUP_INTERVAL_DIAGNOSTIC=1; actual guard sample writes a bracket adjacent to RESOURCE_CPU_PENDING in the current-run journal.
verdict_a.discriminant: Same-PID, same-executable CPU-time deltas classify owned Chromium separately and retain named other-host deltas, so persistent MTLCompilerServi or provjobd work can be distinguished from owned Chromium; process creation, exit, reparenting, and centisecond resolution remain limitations.
verdict_a.acceptance: The rerun is diagnostic only. Any resourceInvalid result remains invalid and earns no native acceptance credit.

verdict_b.guard_preserving: Thresholds, CPU classification, pending/recovery counts, journal verdict, and native action boundaries are unchanged. Process records are bounded to PID, executable basename, category, delta and timestamps; no process arguments are captured.
verdict_b.finding: The claim that sampling cadence is unchanged is not supported: sample() adds before/after ps calls, each with a 5-second command timeout, and the watch loop sleeps only after sample() completes. Diagnostic mode can therefore lengthen watch intervals and delay unsafe confirmation.
verdict_b.evidence: scripts/stabilization-resource.mjs: output timeout, sample()/cpuOutput, and watch loop; scripts/startup-interval-attribution.mjs; scripts/stabilization-resource-journal.mjs sanitizer.

scope: Source and existing journal review only; no rerun, browser, build, or tests performed.
